integrity: General theorem justified by direct one-point diagram analysis and Harris correlation; finite checker corroborates but cannot certify all finite bases. Self-review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only nonalgebraic complete one-point types over finite induced bases of the generic tetrahedron-free 3-hypergraph are counted. The matching inequality need not be exact for longer overlap-graph components. Prior general positive-correlation results make implicit coverage possible; no absolute priority or higher-arity result is asserted.
title: Sharp overlap-matching bounds for one-point types of the generic tetrahedron-free 3-hypergraph
